schedule.note: CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists Walton Pond (Region 2, El Dorado Co.) for catchable-size Rainbow Trout under the Put and Take program, with a stated release month of June. CDFW's release-water name 'Walton Pond' corresponds to the small impoundment mapped as Lake Walton (GNIS 275038) off Balderston Road in northern El Dorado County; third-party stocking trackers report CDFW rainbow trout plants at that same waterbody. This is CDFW's provisional plan for 2026, not a guaranteed annual constant.
